entries.claim: The exact pinned Latin Mass reading corroborates the complete 81-word Introit as a derived digital witness: the antiphon, the verse, the Gloria Patri resolved from the shared Mass prayers, and the repeated antiphon.

The printed antiphon and verse have been checked directly on the Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page, printed p. 381, leaf n462, which then prints only the cues Glória Patri and Suscépimus; the full doxology and the repeated antiphon are a declared expansion. This states current conformity, not original transcription genesis.
